setup.name: eslint-fix
setup.when: files=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD --diff-filter=d && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } ) || exit 2; printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -Eq '\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx)$'
setup.run: { git diff --name-only HEAD --diff-filter=d; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|mjs|cjs|ts|tsx)$' | xargs npx --no-install eslint --fix
